workload_scope: 20 two-tool trace-derived cross-server transitions; not the full Section 5.2 QPS=1-20 sweep

accounting.hit_rate: Eligible requests include any demand preceded since the prior sandbox activation by a completed predictive candidate call with candidate_count > 0, across all worker records. Wrong-target prediction opportunities count as misses.
accounting.false_positive_rate: Discarded effective warmups divided by started effective warmups; late warmups that served a later demand are not false positives.
accounting.resources: Docker group-level CPU and memory sampled integrals, not process-level causal attribution.
accounting.comparison_limit: This is a C2-only short-transition accuracy/overhead experiment, not a matched on-demand or C1 control and not an end-to-end QPS sweep.
